acquisition method: data-dependent acquisition selected the top 10 most abundant precursor ions for tandem mass spectrometry
alkylation reagent: Samples were reduced with dithiothreitol and alkylated with idoacetamide
cleavage agent: followed by trypsin digestion on S-Trap micro
collision energy: normalized collision energy of 30, and a resolution of 30,000
enrichment method: clicked with biotin-N3 for streptavidin agarose precipitation
fragmentation method: tandem mass spectrometry by HCD fragmentation
instrument: delivered to a Q-Exactive HF mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific)
ionization type: using electrospray ionization with a Nano Flex Ion Spray Source
labeling: The relative abundance of each protein was quantified by label-free spectra counting
